properties.name: FIELD LOG 2026-10-06, recorded for later: init on projects it does not own, or that already have a convention, still has three gaps (store in a subdirectory, MCP wording on the terminal route, a second calling convention added silently)
properties.statement:
From the 0.80.0 field log (hxm_program hub and 11 members), not root-caused yet:
- A design whose store lives in a subdirectory (hex-ob: hex-simulated-beamline/.reflow2): init at the repo root would have created a new empty store (`create .reflow2/` in the preview). Worked around by running init in the subdirectory.
- The generated REFLOW2.md / AGENTS.md say reflow2 "is reached through the reflow2 MCP server, already configured in this repo" even for --harness vscode-cli; the .github instructions file correctly says to read that as the terminal commands. The harness should select the wording.
- init added `reflow2 read/write` instructions beside the project's own documented `RUST_LOG=error reflow2-mcp --graph-path … --call` convention, silently: two conventions in one repo. Idea: notice an existing --call convention and offer to update or leave it.
The fourth item from the same entry (the preview omitting steps) is fixed by chg:a-projects-export-path-is-recorded-once-and-read-by-everything-2026-10-06.
